body:
Oh. Oh boy.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4605384/151685262-8c09166a-652c-4c26-ac1b-ff9331667ac0.png)

It seems that the new symbol is part of the NerdFonts CJK overlap issue. See https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/issues/365 for details. In short, several NerdFont symbols bled out of the PUA into the BMP and can override/be overridden by symbols from other human languages.

This is strictly speaking a NerdFonts issue, but I think we should be prepared for some issues about this symbol not appearing correctly on systems with CJK support.
